trinkets.trinketDescription:
You enter a small room filled with books and relics of old. A Cracked Key lays strewn accross a long forgotten writing desk... 
maybe this could be of use somewhere...?
trinkets.takenDescription:
You enter the small room once more, still filled with books and relics of old. The writing desk lays empty now 
There is no more you can do here
trinkets.puzzleDescription:
You enter what looks to be bedroom, weathered by time. You spot a crooked chest of drawers lingering to the right of you, one of the drawers emits a strange energy. 
The drawer is locked... maybe you could find a key somewhere?
trinkets.solvedDescription:
You enter the old bedroom, the drawer hangs open. 
There's no more you can gain here.
trinkets.correctTrinket:
You use the Cracked Key. 
After some fumbling with the lock, the drawer slides open!

trinkets.trinketDescription:
You enter the room, it looks to be some sort of glass workshop
 most of the items here are broken, however, one remains perfectly complete. 
maybe you could take it as a souvenir?
trinkets.takenDescription:
The glass workshop remains shiny and broken.
 There is no more to be gained here
trinkets.puzzleDescription:
You walk into a large dining hall with a tall statue standing at the end. 
The statue's eye gleams with determination, its other eye seems strikingly empty... 
maybe you could find something to complete the statue?
trinkets.solvedDescription:
The statue's eyes shine with glee
 your work here is done!
trinkets.correctTrinket: The Crystal Orb slots right in, the statue happily reveals something from beneath his cloak

trinkets.trinketDescription:
You walk into a room covered in tapestries and unfinished knitting projects, on your left you spy an untouched Ball of Yarn.
 Maybe this could help you later
trinkets.takenDescription: The room is still adorned with beautiful tapestries, not much more for you to do here though.
trinkets.puzzleDescription:
You walk into a dark little room, there seems to be something making noise in the corner, though you can't qutie tell what
 Maybe you can give something to this creature and it could help you..?
trinkets.solvedDescription:
The creature sounds peaceful now.
 Better not disturb it..
trinkets.correctTrinket:
You place the Ball of Yarn infront of the darkness and small paws reach out to grab it. 
Shortly afterwards a little relic rolls out from the darkness.
trinkets.wrongTrinket:
You place the trinket infront of the darknes and wait.
 Nothing much seems to happen, you take back the trinket.

trinkets.trinketDescription:
You walk into a cramped supply closet, empty jars and other junk fills every crevice, a small Salt Lamp pokes out from under some old newspapers. 
Maybe this lantern can light the path to escape
trinkets.takenDescription: The supply cloest is just as cramped as before, nothing else here can help you
trinkets.puzzleDescription:
You open the door and complete darkness surrounds you.
 Maybe if you could find something to light up the room you could explore further
trinkets.solvedDescription: The room isn't so dark now, there doesn't seem to be much more you can gain here
trinkets.correctTrinket:
You bring out the Oil Lantern and the room illuminates before you, 
a small shiny relic sits upon one of the previously hidden shelves.
trinkets.wrongTrinket: You try to light up the room but it doesn't seem to have much effect

trinkets.trinketDescription:
The smell of the room hits you before anything, herbs and ingredients hang from every corner. 
Upon closer inspection most of these ingredients have gone rank, the only item remaining is a bottle labled 'eye of newt'
 maybe this could help you somewhere?
trinkets.takenDescription: The room still smells putrid - there is DEFINITLEY no reason you should need to come back
trinkets.puzzleDescription:
As you enter the room a black cat looks you up and down, it seems to be brewing something... 
The cat seems to be sat stubbornly on a strange looking box. 
Maybe if you help the cat finish it's potion you can see what's in the box?
trinkets.solvedDescription: The cat sits happily infront of the finished brew, liking its paws in pride
trinkets.correctTrinket:
The cat gives the Eye of Newt a long whiff before jumping off the box and snatching it from your hand. Before you know it the brew starts glowing mutli-coloured
 This is your chance to check the box!
trinkets.wrongTrinket:
The cat bats your hand away in a rather unpleased manner
 this doesn't seem to be what he's looking for
